survey: A wall-mounted split air conditioner indoor unit, seen from the front-left at a slight upward angle. The long white rounded body sits flat against the green striped wall. Its right end cap meets the wall flush, with no gap and no floating. The front panel carries a small embossed silver house logo. A thin silver trim line with a shallow step in the middle runs across the lower front. Below it is the air outlet: a recessed slot with evenly spaced vertical vanes and a horizontal louver flap along its lower lip. Stylized blue streams of cool air come out of the outlet and fan downward. The unit has no visible pipes or cables, which is normal because they run behind the unit and through the wall.
